input.rationale: TrueLink's only express warranty is Y2K date handling (Section 9); the Hosting and Support Services carry no conformance warranty, no compliance-with-law or malicious-code warranty and no remedy, while Section 3 obligations are "reasonable commercial efforts" and Section 12 disclaims the implied warranties. We inserted a workmanlike-performance and 90-day conformance warranty with repair/re-perform/refund, expressly carved out of the disclaimer.

input.quote: 30. FORCE MAJEURE. TrueLink will be excused from delays in performing or from failing to perform its obligations under this Agreement to the extent the delays or failures result from causes beyond the reasonable control or TrueLink.
input.rationale: The Agreement contains no insurance provision at all, even though TrueLink hosts our web site and processes borrower credit data. We inserted a short insurance section (CGL USD 1M/2M, E&O USD 2M, cyber USD 5M, workers' compensation) with certificates on request; E&O USD 1M / cyber USD 2M is our fallback.
